role: Validate the live GEL New-tutorial source form as immutable creation-source authority without weakening historical Revision edit-form validation.

form_contract.control_source: canonical edit-control set excluding forbidden fields, with New-specific overrides

tid.reason: PW1 current Standard/Initial/Final New forms expose authenticated-session teacher as hidden tid; Writer has no teacher mutation authority.

form_contract.unknown_non_governed_controls: ignored unless they collide with a governed GEL field name; governed known inapplicable controls fail closed
form_contract.requested_ttype_validation_order: validate canonical returned ttype and requested/returned equality before tutorial-type-specific applicability checks

teacher_authority.session_invalidation: Authentication/session loss invalidates the fetched teacher authority; refetch the New form before any future create.

date_authority.meaning: source default for editable semantic tutorial_date

type_applicability.rule: Field identity determines semantics; equal values in unrelated fields never establish provenance. Known governed controls present for an inapplicable tutorial type are contract drift.

fingerprint.input: normalized validated form method/action/type/teacher/default-date/control statuses and relevant option value domains; never raw HTML bytes or display labels
fingerprint.purpose: detect source-form/state drift deterministically; never substitutes for refetch after session invalidation

failure_semantics: uid missing/non-positive/different from requested route -> fail closed
ttype missing/unknown/different from requested type -> fail closed
canonical returned ttype different from requested type -> requested_type_mismatch before type-specific applicability validation
required applicable control missing/wrong kind/unknown canonical option -> fail closed
known governed inapplicable control present -> contract_drift
validation failure never produces a partial ValidatedNewTutorialForm

fixtures.privacy: Synthetic fixtures use synthetic positive student/teacher IDs and no names, comments, aims, credentials, cookies, tokens or raw private HTML.
